scope: Review and fixes of all pending work, autonomous supported formats and HL3. D40 and deferred point 6 excluded; no commits or pushes.

fixes.finding: Flattened iterator lost the exact size hint, causing geometric Vec growth beyond the cell estimate reservation.
fixes.change: Collect from one exact-size range, with identical row-major arithmetic and predictions.

fixes.finding: Extra root metadata rejected by deny_unknown_fields in the actual bundle.
fixes.change: Only schema/sources in run manifests; generation metadata stays in description.json.

fixes.finding: Nonfinite errors, altered geometry and incoherent legacy/timing evidence could reach the report.
fixes.change: Validate metric domain, complete truth identity, distinct bounded patches, geometry per repeat/campaign, timing population/summaries, and unchanged legacy recipe/hash/metrics. Equal geometry mandatory for quality; native timing crop differences explicit.

fixes.finding: Regional RMS hid local chromatic/detail regressions.
fixes.change: HL diagnostics now retain RGB/chroma/gradient maxima and coordinates, sensor maxima, optional ideal-CFA demosaic control; duel analysis retains existing pixel maxima and regression counts. Dedicated isolated-error regression.

algorithm_review.raw_measurements: Only exactly clipped sites may rise, before gains/demosaic. Near-limit, negative, signed-zero, above-threshold and other nonclipped values remain bit-identical.
algorithm_review.thresholds: DNG linearized WhiteLevel; supported NEF conservative code ceiling independent of nominal normalization; RAF 16383. Physical lower plateaus are not inferred.
algorithm_review.borders: 40 CFA phases, odd dimensions, finite bounded search, complete connected-region admission and original measurements. Unsupported curved colour boundaries remain unrecovered.
algorithm_review.color: No profile or hue adjustment to match legacy. f64 final matrix matches frozen Decimal rounded fp32 reference (1920 components). No new denoiser.
algorithm_review.standalone: Eight supported inputs repeated twice in a standalone tr-raw executable without LibRaw linkage, complete unpack/render/repack hashes. Codec/reference-data provenance and CDDL obligations remain.
algorithm_review.recipe_cache: Numerical production unchanged since frozen review and all photographic outputs repeatable. Allocation/harness/test changes do not alter HL3 recipe/cache identity.

evidence_review.holdout_policy: 160 new analytical scenes generated after source freeze, hashes disjoint from previous 880; no production tuning after observations. Related phases and overlapping regions are not independent physical captures. These data become regressions for a later algorithm change.

legacy_comparison.limits: Legacy is not calibrated truth. New Bayer plane/steps/noise signals improve against their analytical references; curved unsupported boundaries include worse RGB/detail/maxima. Historical fully clipped and unsupported neutral cases can favour legacy, while indistinguishable coloured-light counterexamples expose its neutralization. No general superiority or deletion justification.

native_nef.scope: Three individually complete native NEF source records. The containing run then rejected an additional repacked DNG as outside the legacy contract; that input is excluded, and the run is not declared complete. An independently generated control is measured separately. No other heavy tests concurrent.

equal_geometry_control.scope: One generated uncompressed DNG, identical samples and full active/output geometry. Not a timing of the compressed photographic NEF, nor a general performance result.

performance.conditions: 3 warmups, 30 alternating repetitions per engine/source; repeated complete output hashes; no concurrent heavy tests. Decode/IPC/input hash included, output hashing/metrics excluded. OS cache and thermals uncontrolled; no cold-start or kernel-only claim.

standalone_process.scope: Standalone full unpack/develop/repack sequence, not a per-stage allocation bound or whole machine peak. RUSAGE_CHILDREN on macOS.

performance.memory_limit: Allocation accounting fixed; single-campaign peak RSS and OS supervision do not qualify pressure or release resource guarantees.

functional.environment_limit: Two Core Image tests failed under the extra terminal sandbox, then passed in native verify.sh --gui. No product fallback added.

open: DR6 coloured-step local false colour persists, including ideal unclipped CFA. Four of the new X-Trans phases show larger chroma maxima after valid HL3 recovery; a fifth case has a small larger noisy-gradient peak. Requires qualified demosaic work, not suppression of correct measured/recovered signal to match a score.
Historical Bayer/colour/noise pixel maxima also include local regressions despite nonworsening regional RMS; all listed explicitly.
Fully clipped or unsupported regions and sub-CFA edge positions are ambiguous; no invented calibrated colour.
Physical thresholds, target/illuminant uncertainty, camera profiles and independent RAW photographic colour/detail/noise qualification still missing.
Full X-T5 photographic cross-renderer registration remains insufficient; crop/WB/profile/rendering differences are not calibration truth.
OS memory pressure, cold-start/thermal-controlled timings, broader release isolation gates and R0-R4 remain open. D40 and deferred point 6 were not pursued.
